changes: Added fail-closed hard-budget enforcement to the Claude dispatch seam (Touchpoint 4). In usage-ledger/dispatch-usage.ts (pure, zero cross-module imports): resolveHardBudget (reads LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS, fallback KOALA_, defaults to process.env; null when unset/invalid = no enforcement), isOverHardBudget (strict >), buildBlockedBudgetRecord (decision.kind=blocked, budgetPolicyId, reasonCode=hard_budget_exceeded, supersedes the preflight estimate, validated). recordDispatchPreflight now also returns estimatedInputTokens. In lattice-dispatch.ts: a minimal gated pre-spawn guard (inside isUsageLedgerEnabled) — if a hard budget is configured AND the preflight estimate exceeds it, append the blocked record, SKIP the spawn, and return a well-formed blocked DispatchRunResult (status:failed shape). Budget UNSET or flag OFF => byte-identical dispatch; budget-check error => proceeds (fail-open). Added usage-ledger-budget-smoke.ts (41 checks incl. production-path tests) wired as npm test:usage-ledger-budget.
usage: Set LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS=<N> (with the ledger flag on). If a Claude dispatch's preflight prompt estimate exceeds N tokens, the dispatch is blocked before any provider call and a decision.kind=blocked record is written. Unset the var (default) => no enforcement, dispatch unchanged.
expectedOutcome: With a hard budget set + an over-budget prompt, the dispatch is blocked (no spawn) and a blocked record is recorded; with no budget set or flag off, dispatch is byte-identical. Boundary (estimate==budget) proceeds. A budget-check error never wrongly blocks.
actualTranscript: verify-b-dd44: TOTAL 65 | PASS 65 | FAIL 0 (offByteIdentical budgetFns blockedKind zeroImport noForbidden scopeClean all true). budget smoke 41/41 incl. production-path enforcement checks. No regression (61/50/55/34/38). codex verify green. validate ALL PASS 65/65. 4 reviewers (concept/quality/test-coverage/behavior) passed; round-1 CRITICAL finding F-001 (resolveHardBudget read {} not process.env -> production no-op) fixed + resolved; escalation not required (1/2).
limitations: Claude-host only (other hosts have no live call). Hard budget compares the PREFLIGHT bytes/chars estimate (coarse, low-confidence) — a real count_tokens estimate would be more precise (future). No postflight overage remediation, no Authority-required budget modes, no default-on. Opt-in: enforcement only when LATTICE_HARD_BUDGET_TOKENS is set + ledger flag on.
pitfalls: NEVER invent a budget: unset => proceed (budgetPolicyId=null). Keep the OFF/unset path byte-identical and the budget-check fail-open (an error must not block). resolveHardBudget must default to process.env (the F-001 bug was reading {}). The blocked record supersedes the estimate and is never provider-reported. Budget is on the coarse preflight estimate, not real usage.
